translations.web: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.
translations.bsb: The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples made by human hands.
translations.kjv: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
